achievements.name: Banner at Dawn
achievements.rule: Finish the Prologue.

achievements.name: First Blood
achievements.rule: Win a battle in a run.

achievements.name: Past the First Gate
achievements.rule: Defeat an Act I boss.

achievements.name: Deeper Roads
achievements.rule: Win a battle in Act III.

achievements.name: First Light
achievements.rule: Win a run on First Light.

achievements.name: Down the Stair
achievements.rule: Win a battle in the Descent.

achievements.name: Into the Dusk
achievements.rule: Win a run on Dusk.

achievements.name: The Glass Breaks
achievements.rule: Defeat the Lieutenant at the Descent's gate.

achievements.name: The Sleeper Falls
achievements.rule: Defeat the Entity.

achievements.name: Black Sun
achievements.rule: Win a run on Black Sun.

achievements.name: Every Rung
achievements.rule: Win a run on all four difficulties.

achievements.name: Kingslayer's Ledger
achievements.rule: Slay every act boss at least once.

achievements.name: Who Rides Again
achievements.rule: Win a battle in an NG+ run with a veteran riding again.

achievements.name: Seize the Day
achievements.rule: Win a seize battle.

achievements.name: Ahead of the Dark
achievements.rule: Win a battle 3 turns under par.

achievements.name: Not a Scratch
achievements.rule: Defeat 6 or more foes in a battle without a foe's blow landing on an ally.

achievements.name: All Out
achievements.rule: Win an escape battle with every unit escaping alive.

achievements.name: Heavy Hand
achievements.rule: Deal 50 or more damage in a single blow.

achievements.name: Red Harvest
achievements.rule: One unit defeats 10 foes in a single battle.

achievements.name: Shatter
achievements.rule: Break every Revival Stone of a boss and defeat it in one player phase.

achievements.name: Dawn Strike
achievements.rule: Win a battle on turn 1.

achievements.name: Encore
achievements.rule: Refresh 3 allies with one Goddess Dance.

achievements.name: Light Fingers
achievements.rule: Steal an item a foe carries.

achievements.name: Cutpurse
achievements.rule: Steal 15 items.

achievements.name: Bolt from the Blue
achievements.rule: Defeat a boss with a captured ballista.

achievements.name: Rink
achievements.rule: Send a foe 4 or more tiles with one Smite.

achievements.name: Bone Dry
achievements.rule: Defeat a Necromancer before it raises a single Skeleton.

achievements.name: Silent Vigil
achievements.rule: Win the Vigil without a circle calling a Hollowed.

achievements.name: Root and Branch
achievements.rule: Defeat the Entity before a single Grasping Limb sprouts.

achievements.name: Talked Down
achievements.rule: Recruit a unit by talking to them.

achievements.name: New Colours
achievements.rule: Promote a unit.

achievements.name: A Name to Remember
achievements.rule: A unit earns an epithet.

achievements.name: Sworn
achievements.rule: Promote a unit who swears an Oath.

achievements.name: Spoils of War
achievements.rule: Take a recruit from a boss's draft.

achievements.name: Marked
achievements.rule: Recruit a unit who bears a Mark.

achievements.name: Five Marks
achievements.rule: Recruit units bearing each of the five Marks.

achievements.name: Perfect Year
achievements.rule: A level-up raises every stat.

achievements.name: Living Legend
achievements.rule: One unit holds 5 deeds.

achievements.name: Full Banner
achievements.rule: Have all seven lords in one army.

achievements.name: Lone Lord
achievements.rule: Win a battle in Act III or later with only your commander deployed.

achievements.name: Nobody Left Behind
achievements.rule: Win a run on Nightfall or Black Sun with no ally ever falling.

achievements.name: Every Deed
achievements.rule: Earn every deed at least once.

achievements.name: Seven Banners
achievements.rule: Win a run with each lord as commander.

achievements.name: A Vow Taken
achievements.rule: Take a blessing at a church.

achievements.name: A Price Paid
achievements.rule: Take a card an act boss offers.

achievements.name: Not Today
achievements.rule: Rewind a battle with Vision.

achievements.name: Cleansed
achievements.rule: Cleanse a burden at a church.

achievements.name: Paid in Full
achievements.rule: Collect a contract's reward.

achievements.name: Dark Omen
achievements.rule: Walk through a Dark Omen.

achievements.name: Old Stones
achievements.rule: Find an Old Sanctum.

achievements.name: Under the Dark
achievements.rule: Win an eclipsed elite battle.

achievements.name: Crowd Pleaser
achievements.rule: Win a gold bout at the Colosseum.

achievements.name: Champion of the Pit
achievements.rule: Win a platinum bout at the Colosseum.

achievements.name: Deep Pockets
achievements.rule: Hold 10,000 gold at once.

achievements.name: Masterwork
achievements.rule: Forge one weapon 10 times.

achievements.name: One of a Kind
achievements.rule: Find an epic weapon.

achievements.name: Trophy Hunter
achievements.rule: Claim a boss's trophy weapon.

achievements.name: Every Road a Tale
achievements.rule: See every Event.

achievements.name: Armory of Legends
achievements.rule: Hold every epic weapon at least once.

achievements.name: Self-Reliant
achievements.rule: Win a run without buying from a shop.

achievements.name: Clear Sight
achievements.rule: Win a run on Nightfall or Black Sun without using Vision.

achievements.name: Few and Proud
achievements.rule: Win a run holding The Chosen Few.

achievements.name: On Schedule
achievements.rule: Win a run on Nightfall or Black Sun with every battle at or under par.

achievements.name: No Blessing
achievements.rule: Win a run on Black Sun after choosing No blessing at the shrine.

achievements.name: The Unbroken Thread
achievements.rule: Win a run on Black Sun with no ally falling and no Vision used.

achievements.name: Not This Thread
achievements.rule: Lose someone you must not lose in the Prologue.

achievements.name: Third Time
achievements.rule: Defeat a boss that has beaten you three times.

achievements.name: Unfathomed
achievements.rule: Land a critical hit on the Entity.

achievements.name: The Herald's Ear
achievements.rule: Defeat the Entity on Black Sun after hearing the Herald.
